Education.description: Challenges related to access, quality, infrastructure, teaching, learning and educational opportunities.

School Infrastructure.description: Problems with school buildings, classrooms, toilets, furniture, laboratories, libraries and basic facilities.

Teacher Availability.description: Shortage, absence or uneven distribution of teachers and educators.

Digital Learning.description: Problems related to internet access, computers, smart classrooms and digital educational resources.

Student Access and Attendance.description: Barriers preventing children from attending or continuing education.
examples: Children unable to attend school regularly

Vocational and Skill Education.description: Problems related to practical skills, vocational training and employment-oriented education.

Higher Education.description: Challenges involving colleges, universities, higher education access and academic resources.

Healthcare.description: Challenges related to healthcare access, medical facilities, medicines, diagnosis and public health.

Primary Healthcare.description: Access to basic healthcare services, health centres and primary medical treatment.
examples: Village has no primary health centre

Medical Staff Availability.description: Shortage or absence of doctors, nurses, technicians and other healthcare workers.
examples: No doctor available at health centre

Medicine Availability.description: Problems involving availability, distribution or access to essential medicines.
examples: Patients must travel far to buy medicines

Diagnostics and Testing.description: Lack of diagnostic equipment, laboratories and medical testing facilities.

Maternal and Child Health.description: Challenges related to pregnancy, childbirth, newborns and children's healthcare.
examples: Pregnant women travel long distances for treatment

Emergency Healthcare.description: Problems related to emergency treatment, ambulances and urgent medical response.

Telemedicine and Health Technology.description: Problems that could be addressed through telemedicine, digital health systems or health technology.

Agriculture.description: Challenges related to farming, crops, livestock, agricultural resources, productivity and farmer support.

Crop Production.description: Problems affecting crop cultivation, productivity and farming practices.

Agricultural Irrigation.description: Problems with water availability and irrigation specifically for agricultural activities.

Crop Disease and Pest Management.description: Crop diseases, pests and difficulties in detecting or controlling them.

Soil Health.description: Problems involving soil quality, fertility, erosion and soil management.

Agricultural Storage.description: Problems involving warehouses, cold storage and preservation of agricultural products.

Agricultural Market Access.description: Challenges involving selling crops, market information, pricing and access to buyers.
examples: Farmers lack direct access to markets

Livestock and Dairy.description: Challenges involving cattle, goats, poultry, dairy production and animal health.

Fisheries.description: Problems involving fish farming, fisheries resources and aquaculture.

Water Resources.description: Challenges related to drinking water, water quality, groundwater, water conservation and water management.

Drinking Water Access.description: Problems involving availability and accessibility of safe drinking water.
examples: Village has no reliable drinking water

Water Quality.description: Problems involving contaminated, unsafe or polluted drinking and surface water.

Groundwater Management.description: Problems involving groundwater depletion, monitoring and sustainable groundwater use.

Water Conservation.description: Challenges related to rainwater harvesting, water conservation and sustainable water usage.
examples: Large amounts of water are wasted

Flood Management.description: Problems involving flooding, flood preparedness, flood control and waterlogging.

Water Supply Infrastructure.description: Problems involving pipelines, pumps, tanks and other water supply infrastructure.
examples: Overhead water tank is not functioning

Sanitation.description: Challenges related to sanitation, hygiene, sewage, toilets and waste management.

Toilet Access.description: Problems involving availability, accessibility and maintenance of toilets.

Sewage and Wastewater.description: Problems involving sewage systems, wastewater disposal and treatment.

Solid Waste Management.description: Problems involving garbage collection, segregation, disposal and recycling.
examples: Waste is dumped in open areas

Public Hygiene.description: Challenges related to cleanliness, hygiene awareness and sanitation practices.

Drainage and Waterlogging.description: Problems involving blocked drains, poor drainage and local waterlogging.

Environment.description: Challenges related to environmental protection, pollution, ecosystems, forests and climate resilience.

Air Pollution.description: Problems involving harmful air pollution from vehicles, industries, burning and other sources.

Water Pollution.description: Pollution of rivers, lakes, ponds and other water bodies.

Forest Conservation.description: Challenges involving forests, deforestation and protection of forest resources.

Biodiversity and Wildlife.description: Problems involving wildlife, biodiversity and protection of natural ecosystems.

Climate Resilience.description: Challenges caused by climate change and the need to adapt communities and infrastructure.

Environmental Monitoring.description: Need for monitoring environmental conditions, pollution and ecological changes.
examples: No monitoring of local air quality

Energy.description: Challenges related to electricity access, energy reliability, renewable energy and energy efficiency.

Electricity Access.description: Problems involving lack of electricity or limited access to electrical power.

Power Reliability.description: Frequent outages, voltage problems and unreliable electricity supply.

Renewable Energy.description: Challenges or opportunities involving solar, wind, biomass and other renewable energy sources.

Energy Efficiency.description: Problems involving inefficient energy use and opportunities to reduce energy consumption.

Clean Cooking Energy.description: Problems involving access to clean and safe cooking energy.

Urban Infrastructure.description: Challenges related to roads, transport, public infrastructure, housing and urban services.

Roads and Streets.description: Problems involving roads, potholes, damaged streets and road connectivity.

Public Transport.description: Problems involving buses, public transportation availability, connectivity and accessibility.
examples: Remote area has no bus service

Street Lighting.description: Problems involving street lights and lighting of public areas.

Housing and Shelter.description: Challenges involving inadequate housing, unsafe homes and shelter facilities.

Public Infrastructure.description: Problems involving public spaces, community facilities and other physical infrastructure.

Traffic and Road Safety.description: Problems involving traffic management, accidents, crossings and road safety.

Accessibility.description: Challenges related to inclusion and access for persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups.

Physical Accessibility.description: Accessibility of buildings, roads, toilets and public spaces for persons with disabilities.
examples: Public toilet is inaccessible to wheelchair users

Accessible Transport.description: Problems involving transportation access for persons with disabilities.

Assistive Technology.description: Lack of devices and technologies that support people with disabilities.

Inclusive Education.description: Barriers preventing persons with disabilities from accessing education.
examples: School lacks facilities for visually impaired students

Digital Accessibility.description: Problems preventing people with disabilities from using digital services and information.
examples: Government website is not screen-reader friendly

Public Administration.description: Challenges related to government services, public service delivery, citizen grievances and administrative processes.

Public Service Delivery.description: Problems involving delays, inefficiency or lack of access to government services.
examples: Citizens cannot access a public service

Government Schemes.description: Problems involving awareness, access, implementation or delivery of government welfare schemes.
examples: Eligible citizens do not receive benefits
People are unaware of available schemes

Documents and Certificates.description: Problems involving birth certificates, caste certificates, income certificates and other official documents.

Citizen Grievance Management.description: Problems involving reporting, tracking and resolution of citizen complaints.

Transparency and Accountability.description: Challenges involving transparency, monitoring and accountability in public services.
examples: Lack of transparency in local projects

Civic Information Access.description: Problems involving access to information about government services, policies and public resources.
examples: Citizens do not know where to apply
Government information is difficult to access

Rural Livelihoods.description: Challenges related to rural employment, skills, entrepreneurship, self-help groups and income opportunities.

Rural Employment.description: Problems involving lack of employment and sustainable income opportunities in rural areas.
examples: Young people cannot find local jobs

Skill Development.description: Lack of training and skills needed for employment or entrepreneurship.
examples: Lack of local skill development centres

Self Help Groups.description: Challenges involving women's self-help groups, community groups and their economic activities.

Rural Entrepreneurship.description: Challenges faced by people starting or operating small businesses in rural areas.

Handicrafts and Traditional Industries.description: Challenges involving artisans, handicrafts, traditional products and local industries.

Financial and Market Access.description: Problems involving access to finance, markets, customers and business opportunities.
examples: Rural producers struggle to reach markets
